-- Candidate-only records remain released source products, separate from graph values.
-- Invoked by protected publication in the same receipt transaction.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.validate_source_record_structure(r text, source_record jsonb)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $fn$
DECLARE projection jsonb; family jsonb; field jsonb; alternative jsonb; anchor jsonb;
 evidence jsonb; role jsonb; scalar jsonb; schema json; family_fields jsonb; fields_by_role jsonb;
 expected text; pin jsonb;
 provider jsonb; observation jsonb; reconstruction jsonb; reconstructed_text text;
BEGIN
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO projection FROM sem.artifact
  WHERE release_id=r AND artifact_name='record_projection.json';
 IF projection->>'abi' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-projection-1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported released source record structure' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT value INTO family FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection->'families')
  WHERE value->>'contract'=source_record->>'contract';
 IF family IS NULL OR (source_record->>'family',source_record->>'occurrence_recipe') IS DISTINCT FROM
  (family->>'family',family->>'occurrence_recipe') OR source_record->>'occurrence_recipe'<>'source-anchor-membership-1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record is outside released source family' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::json INTO schema FROM sem.artifact
  WHERE release_id=r AND artifact_name='json_schema/SourceRecord';
 IF schema IS NULL OR NOT public.json_matches_schema(schema,source_record::json) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source record differs from released schema' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF COALESCE(source_record->>'policy_version','')='' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record requires a nonempty interpretation policy version' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('family',source_record->'family','occurrence_recipe',source_record->'occurrence_recipe')
  ||COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(value->>'role',value),'{}'::jsonb) INTO family_fields
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'fields');
 fields_by_role:=family_fields-'family'-'occurrence_recipe';
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::json INTO schema FROM sem.artifact
  WHERE release_id=r AND artifact_name='json_schema/'||(source_record->>'contract');
 IF schema IS NULL OR NOT public.json_matches_schema(schema,family_fields::json) OR
  jsonb_array_length(source_record->'fields')<>jsonb_array_length(family->'roles') OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'fields') f GROUP BY f->>'role' HAVING count(*)<>1) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') a GROUP BY a->>'anchor_id' HAVING count(*)<>1) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) e GROUP BY e->>'set_id' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record family roles or collection identities differ' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR anchor IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') LOOP
  pin:=(anchor->'pin')-'source_view_id';
  expected:='record-anchor:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(
   (anchor-'anchor_id')||jsonb_build_object('pin',pin)),'UTF8')),'hex');
  IF anchor->>'anchor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record anchor identity differs from content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF anchor->>'space'='model_context' OR
   (anchor ? 'start') IS DISTINCT FROM (anchor ? 'end') OR
   (anchor->>'precision'='exact' AND (NOT anchor ? 'start' OR NOT anchor ? 'source_piece' OR
    (anchor->>'start')::bigint>=(anchor->>'end')::bigint OR
    (anchor->>'end')::bigint-(anchor->>'start')::bigint<>char_length(anchor->>'source_piece'))) OR
   (anchor->>'precision'<>'exact' AND anchor ? 'start') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record anchor invents model evidence or invalid source bounds' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF anchor ? 'binding' THEN
   IF anchor->'binding' NOT IN (
    '{"version":2,"relationship":"primary","policy":"attributed-selected-source-2"}'::jsonb,
    '{"version":2,"relationship":"selected_context","policy":"attributed-selected-source-2"}'::jsonb) OR
    (anchor->'binding'->>'relationship'='primary' AND anchor->'pin' IS DISTINCT FROM source_record->'pin') OR
    (anchor->'binding'->>'relationship'='selected_context' AND
     (anchor->'pin'->'native_product_task_id',anchor->'pin'->'product_key',anchor->'pin'->'product_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM
     (source_record->'pin'->'native_product_task_id',source_record->'pin'->'product_key',source_record->'pin'->'product_digest')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'record anchor has unsupported or contradictory source binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF anchor->'pin' IS DISTINCT FROM source_record->'pin' OR anchor->>'space'='captured_recognition' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record anchor lacks its attributed source binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF anchor->>'space'='captured_recognition' THEN
   IF NOT anchor ? 'recognition' OR anchor->>'precision'<>'exact' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition lacks exact typed address' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   BEGIN
    provider:=(anchor->'recognition'->>'provider_occurrence_json')::jsonb;
    observation:=(anchor->'recognition'->>'observation_json')::jsonb;
   EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition has malformed retained JSON' USING ERRCODE='23514';
   END;
   IF jsonb_typeof(provider) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(observation) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
    provider->>'occurrence_id' IS DISTINCT FROM anchor->'recognition'->>'occurrence_id' OR
    jsonb_typeof(provider->'text') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR
    COALESCE(provider->>'precision','') NOT IN ('unknown','coarse','block') OR provider ? 'start' OR provider ? 'end' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition alters supported provider occurrence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF anchor ? 'recognition' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'recognition address cannot reinterpret canonical coordinates' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(source_record->'occurrence_anchors')<1 OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(source_record->'occurrence_anchors') a GROUP BY a HAVING count(*)<>1) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(source_record->'occurrence_anchors') a WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') actual WHERE actual->>'anchor_id'=a)) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(source_record->'occurrence_anchors') a,
   jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') actual WHERE actual->>'anchor_id'=a AND
   (actual->'pin' IS DISTINCT FROM source_record->'pin' OR actual->>'space'='captured_recognition' OR
    COALESCE(actual->'binding'->>'relationship','primary')<>'primary')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid record occurrence anchor membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:='record:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
  r,source_record->'family',source_record->'occurrence_recipe',(source_record->'pin')-'source_view_id',
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(a ORDER BY a COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(source_record->'occurrence_anchors') a))),'UTF8')),'hex');
 IF source_record->>'record_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record occurrence identity differs from released source membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR evidence IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) LOOP
  IF NOT fields_by_role ? (evidence->>'role') OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') a GROUP BY a HAVING count(*)<>1) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') a WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') actual WHERE actual->>'anchor_id'=a)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid record evidence set role or anchor membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  expected:='record-set:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
   evidence->'role',evidence->'ordering',evidence->'usage',CASE WHEN evidence->>'ordering'='unordered' THEN
   (SELECT jsonb_agg(a ORDER BY a COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') a)
   ELSE evidence->'anchors' END)),'UTF8')),'hex');
  IF evidence->>'set_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record evidence set identity differs from content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR field IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'fields') LOOP
  SELECT value INTO role FROM jsonb_array_elements(family->'roles') WHERE value->>'role'=field->>'role';
  IF role IS NULL OR field->'meaning_changing' IS DISTINCT FROM role->'meaning_changing' OR
   (field->>'evidence_status'='available') IS DISTINCT FROM (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]'))>0) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]')) e GROUP BY e HAVING count(*)<>1) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]')) e WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) actual
    WHERE actual->>'set_id'=e AND actual->>'role'=field->>'role')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record field role or evidence membership differs from released meaning' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(field->'premises','[]')) premise
   WHERE NOT fields_by_role ? premise) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record premise role is unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF field->>'state'<>'present' THEN
   IF field ? 'value' OR field ? 'original' OR field ? 'original_pieces' OR COALESCE(field->>'reason','')='' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'nonpresent record field invents a value or lacks reason' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE
   scalar:=field->'value';
   IF scalar IS NULL OR (field->>'evidence_status'='unavailable' AND COALESCE(field->>'reason','')='') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'present record field lacks value or unavailable-evidence reason' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF field->>'kind'='classified' AND (NOT (projection->'classification_kinds' ? (scalar->>'kind')) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) s
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (s->>'set_id') AND s->>'usage'<>'classification_cue')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'classified record value is not a located classification cue' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF field->>'kind'='native' AND (scalar->>'kind'<>'native_location' OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) s,
     jsonb_array_elements_text(s->'anchors') a, jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (s->>'set_id') AND s->>'usage'='native'
      AND piece->>'anchor_id'=a AND piece->>'space'='native' AND piece->>'pointer'=scalar->>'pointer') OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) s
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (s->>'set_id') AND s->>'usage'<>'native')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'native record value lacks actual native pointer evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF field->>'kind'='literal' AND (
    (field ? 'original')=(field ? 'original_pieces') OR
    (scalar->>'kind'='text_sequence' AND scalar->'items' IS DISTINCT FROM field->'original_pieces') OR
    (scalar->>'kind'<>'text_sequence' AND (scalar->>'kind' NOT IN ('text','decimal') OR
     COALESCE(scalar->>'text',scalar->>'lexical') IS DISTINCT FROM field->>'original')) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) s
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (s->>'set_id') AND s->>'usage'<>'literal')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'literal record value differs from original spelling or evidence usage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF source_record->>'standing'='accepted' AND field->>'kind'='literal' THEN
    IF jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]'))=0 OR EXISTS(
     SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) e,
      jsonb_array_elements_text(e->'anchors') a, jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece
      WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (e->>'set_id') AND piece->>'anchor_id'=a
       AND piece->>'precision'<>'exact') THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted literal field needs exact located evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    -- Each complete set independently establishes the field. Never union sets to
    -- invent repeated source pieces; partition overlap checks by genuine coordinate.
    FOR evidence IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]'))
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (value->>'set_id') LOOP
     IF jsonb_array_length(evidence->'anchors')>1 AND evidence->>'ordering'<>'ordered' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'literal reconstruction requires ordered evidence set' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
     IF EXISTS(WITH ordered AS (
      SELECT piece,(piece->>'start')::bigint AS source_start,
       lag((piece->>'end')::bigint,1,0::bigint) OVER (
        PARTITION BY (piece->'pin')-'source_view_id',piece->>'space',piece->>'pointer',piece->'recognition'
        ORDER BY member.ordinality) AS previous_end
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') WITH ORDINALITY member(anchor_id,ordinality)
       JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece ON piece->>'anchor_id'=member.anchor_id)
      SELECT FROM ordered WHERE source_start<previous_end) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'literal evidence intervals overlap or reverse source order' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
     IF NOT field ? 'original_pieces' AND jsonb_array_length(evidence->'anchors')>1 AND EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') member,
       jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece WHERE piece->>'anchor_id'=member AND piece ? 'binding') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'attributed multi-piece literals require original pieces' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
     SELECT jsonb_agg(piece->'source_piece' ORDER BY member.ordinality),
      string_agg(piece->>'source_piece','' ORDER BY member.ordinality) INTO reconstruction,reconstructed_text
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(evidence->'anchors') WITH ORDINALITY member(anchor_id,ordinality)
       JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece ON piece->>'anchor_id'=member.anchor_id;
     IF (field ? 'original_pieces' AND reconstruction IS DISTINCT FROM field->'original_pieces') OR
      (NOT field ? 'original_pieces' AND reconstructed_text IS DISTINCT FROM field->>'original') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'literal field does not reconstruct complete evidence set' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;
   END IF;
   IF field->>'kind' IN ('normalized','derived') AND (COALESCE(field->>'policy','')='' OR
    (field->>'kind'='normalized' AND COALESCE(field->>'original','')='') OR
    (field->>'kind'='derived' AND (COALESCE(field->>'rule','')='' OR jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(field->'premises','[]'))=0 OR
     EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(field->'premises') p WHERE p=field->>'role' OR
      NOT fields_by_role ? p OR fields_by_role->p->>'state'<>'present')))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'transformed record field lacks policy or valid present premises' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(field->'alternatives','[]')) a
    GROUP BY a->>'alternative_id' HAVING count(*)<>1) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(field->'alternatives','[]')) a,
     jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(a->'evidence_sets','[]')) e WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) s
       WHERE s->>'set_id'=e AND s->>'role'=field->>'role')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid record field alternative evidence membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF source_record->>'standing'='accepted' THEN
   IF ((role->>'required')::boolean AND field->>'state'<>'present') OR
    (field->>'state'='unresolved' AND (role->>'meaning_changing')::boolean) OR
    ((role->>'required')::boolean AND field->>'evidence_status'<>'available') OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) e,
     jsonb_array_elements_text(e->'anchors') a, jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'anchors') piece
     WHERE COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]') ? (e->>'set_id') AND piece->>'anchor_id'=a
      AND piece->>'precision'='unavailable') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted record lacks released complete roles or located evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE edges(role,premise) AS (
  SELECT f->>'role',p FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'fields') f,
   jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(f->'premises','[]')) p),
  reach(role,premise) AS (SELECT * FROM edges UNION SELECT reach.role,edges.premise FROM reach JOIN edges ON reach.premise=edges.role)
  SELECT FROM reach WHERE reach.role=reach.premise) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record field premises form a cycle' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:='record-interpretation:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
  source_record->'record_id',source_record->'contract',source_record->'policy_version',
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(f ORDER BY f->>'role' COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'fields') f),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(e ORDER BY e->>'set_id' COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(source_record->'evidence_sets','[]')) e),'[]'),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(d ORDER BY d COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(source_record->'computation_dependencies','[]')) d),'[]'),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a ORDER BY a COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(source_record->'assertion_members','[]')) a),'[]'))),'UTF8')),'hex');
 IF source_record->>'interpretation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record interpretation identity differs from private fields or dependencies' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $fn$

DECLARE selected_cut bigint;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.source_record s LEFT JOIN data.record_admission a
  ON (a.release_id,a.realization_id,a.record_id,a.interpretation_id)=(s.release_id,s.realization_id,s.record_id,s.interpretation_id)
  WHERE s.release_id=r AND s.realization_id=z AND
   (a.record_id IS NULL OR s.standing='accepted' OR a.decision IS DISTINCT FROM s.standing OR
    (a.policy_id,a.policy_version,a.calibration,a.reason) IS DISTINCT FROM
    ('m1-candidate-only','1','not_calibrated','Retained source interpretation; accepted record admission is unavailable'))) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate record admission refuses accepted decisions or public assertion bindings' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.source_record s WHERE s.release_id=r AND s.realization_id=z AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM data.record_report_member m WHERE (m.release_id,m.realization_id,m.record_id,m.interpretation_id)=
   (s.release_id,s.realization_id,s.record_id,s.interpretation_id))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'public record lacks selected report provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Stages have already passed publisher-owned shape/owner verification in transport.
 -- Every write of record rows rechecks the complete cut, including ordinary append
 -- callers; the public append wrapper additionally refuses record transport entirely.
 IF to_regclass('pg_temp.sp_record_report') IS NOT NULL AND
  (EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_source_record) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report_member) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field_piece) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative_piece) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_anchor) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_occurrence_anchor) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_evidence_set) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_evidence_member) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field_evidence) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative_evidence) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_premise) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_dependency) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_private_assertion) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_admission) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_assertion)) THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record publication lacks staged sealed-cut report provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR selected_cut IN SELECT DISTINCT cut_id FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report LOOP
   PERFORM data.validate_record_projection_cut(r,z,selected_cut);
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
END

BEGIN

  ON (a.release_id,a.realization_id,a.record_id,a.interpretation_id)=(s.release_id,s.realization_id,s.record_id,s.interpretation_id)

  SELECT FROM data.record_report_member m WHERE (m.release_id,m.realization_id,m.record_id,m.interpretation_id)=
   (s.release_id,s.realization_id,s.record_id,s.interpretation_id))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'public record lacks selected report provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Stages have already passed publisher-owned shape/owner verification in transport.
 -- Every write of record rows rechecks the complete cut, including ordinary append
 -- callers; the public append wrapper additionally refuses record transport entirely.
 IF to_regclass('pg_temp.sp_record_report') IS NOT NULL AND
  (EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_source_record) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report_member) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field_piece) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative_piece) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_anchor) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_occurrence_anchor) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_evidence_set) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_evidence_member) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_field_evidence) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_alternative_evidence) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_premise) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_dependency) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_private_assertion) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_admission) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_assertion)) THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp.sp_record_report) THEN

DECLARE placement ops.pdf_published_revision; selected_body jsonb; relation_body jsonb;
 provider jsonb; observation jsonb; captured text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT placement FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_key,p_digest);
 SELECT c.body INTO STRICT selected_body FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
  p_task,p_key,p_digest,ARRAY[p_pointer],p_pointer) c
  WHERE c.family='occurrence' AND c.local_id=p_address->>'selected_occurrence_id';
 IF selected_body->>'pointer' IS DISTINCT FROM p_pointer THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition selected occurrence differs from source pointer' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT c.body INTO STRICT relation_body FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
  p_task,p_key,p_digest,ARRAY[p_pointer],p_pointer) c
  WHERE c.family='relation' AND c.local_id=p_address->>'relation_id';
 IF p_address->>'endpoint_role' NOT IN ('input','evidence','alternative')
  OR p_address->>'relation_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision'
  OR relation_body->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM p_address->>'relation_kind'
  OR relation_body->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM p_address->>'relation_outcome'
  OR relation_body->>'outcome' NOT IN ('selected','added','replaced','retained_alternative')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=placement.build_id
   AND e.revision_id=placement.build_id AND e.relation_id=p_address->>'relation_id'
   AND e.role='output' AND e.occurrence_id=p_address->>'selected_occurrence_id'
   AND ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=(p_task,p_key,p_digest)
    OR (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=(0,'@self','@self')))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e WHERE e.product_id=placement.build_id
   AND e.revision_id=placement.build_id AND e.relation_id=p_address->>'relation_id'
   AND e.role=p_address->>'endpoint_role' AND e.occurrence_id=p_address->>'occurrence_id'
   AND (e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest)=
    ((p_address->>'task_id')::bigint,p_address->>'product_key',p_address->>'content_digest')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported or forged captured recognition decision lineage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT o.body,b.descriptor->'observation' INTO STRICT provider,observation
  FROM kb.pdf_occurrence o JOIN ops.pdf_product p USING(task_id,product_key)
  JOIN ops.pdf_product_body b USING(task_id,product_key)
  WHERE o.task_id=(p_address->>'task_id')::bigint AND o.product_key=p_address->>'product_key'
   AND p.content_digest=p_address->>'content_digest' AND p.kind='recognition_observation'
   AND encode(sha256(b.payload),'hex')=p.content_digest
   AND o.occurrence_id=p_address->>'occurrence_id';
 IF provider IS DISTINCT FROM (p_address->>'provider_occurrence_json')::jsonb
  OR observation IS DISTINCT FROM (p_address->>'observation_json')::jsonb
  OR provider->>'precision' NOT IN ('unknown','coarse','block')
  OR provider ? 'start' OR provider ? 'end' OR jsonb_typeof(provider->'text') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition provider custody or original precision differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 captured:=provider->>'text';
 RETURN captured;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'captured recognition has no unique admitted retained lineage/body' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END

catalog.arguments: p_project text, p_run bigint, p_release text, p_task bigint, p_product text, p_digest text, p_section text, p_membership text, p_policy text
catalog.body:
DECLARE revision ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants'
 OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid selected source selector/policy' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT revision FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(
 p_project,p_run,p_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE a.product_id=revision.build_id
 AND a.revision_id=revision.build_id AND a.pointer=p_section
 AND a.label IN ('section','chapter')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected source root is not a published section' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), access AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
 ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), subtree(pointer) AS (
 SELECT pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section
 UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer FROM access child JOIN subtree parent
 ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM subtree)
 ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
 SELECT parent_pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section AND parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN ancestors p ON a.pointer=p.pointer
 WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), contained(record_id) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 JOIN selected a ON a.pointer=n.native_address
 UNION
 SELECT child.record_id FROM contained parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.record_id=parent.record_id JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 WHERE m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
 AND m.parent_id=n.record_id AND m.value_kind='record'
 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata

 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,1,part.ordinal,jsonb_build_object('kind','part','part',to_jsonb(part))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_part part USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,2,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','close') FROM metadata_companions c
),
 companion AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text AS payload
 FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_product,p_digest,
 ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,
 c.body::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='health'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id

 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position

 ), external AS (

 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id

 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),

 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',

 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL

 FROM selected
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,

 UNION ALL

 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,
 'family',family,'local_id',local_id,'ordinal',ordinal) FROM companion_order
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.position
 ORDER BY e.phase,e.field_name COLLATE "C",e.subphase,e.part_ordinal)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_fragment','fragment',e.event)
 FROM metadata_events e JOIN companion_order c ON c.family='native_metadata'
 AND c.local_id=e.local_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_end')
 FROM companion_order WHERE family='native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY body::text)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','outside_reference','body',body) FROM external
 ) SELECT event FROM output ORDER BY phase,path;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_selected_source_events(
 p_project text,p_run bigint,p_release text,p_task bigint,p_product text,p_digest text,
 p_section text,p_membership text,p_policy text)
RETURNS SETOF jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $selected$
DECLARE revision ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants'
 OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid selected source selector/policy' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT revision FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(
 p_project,p_run,p_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE a.product_id=revision.build_id
 AND a.revision_id=revision.build_id AND a.pointer=p_section
 AND a.label IN ('section','chapter')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected source root is not a published section' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), access AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
 ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), subtree(pointer) AS (
 SELECT pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section
 UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer FROM access child JOIN subtree parent
 ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM subtree)
 ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
 SELECT parent_pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section AND parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN ancestors p ON a.pointer=p.pointer
 WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), contained(record_id) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 JOIN selected a ON a.pointer=n.native_address
 UNION
 SELECT child.record_id FROM contained parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.record_id=parent.record_id JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 WHERE m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
 AND m.parent_id=n.record_id AND m.value_kind='record'
 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata
), metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT cf.*,c.ordinal AS row_ordinal FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field cf
 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))

 UNION ALL

 c.body::text

 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT c.local_id FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM companion
 ), external AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer',a.pointer,'field',r.field_name,
 'reference_id',r.reference_id,'source_id',r.source_id,'native_address',origin.native_address,
 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='relation')
 AND NOT ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest) IN
 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),
 'membership_sha256',(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(
 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',
 'pointer',a.pointer,'record_id',n.record_id,'ordinal',a.ordinal,'parent_pointer',a.parent_pointer,
 'section_pointer',a.section_pointer,'label',a.label,'role','selected')
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,path,jsonb_build_object('event','native_fragment','native',
 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[ordinal,3]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_end','pointer',pointer)

 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,
 'name',native_json->'name') FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY r.pointer,r.region_index)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','frame','body',to_jsonb(r)-'product_id'-'revision_id')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id

 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,

 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'

 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'

-- Extend the existing final validation composition (frozen0027); preserve its
-- contract, conditional and identity-exclusion validators in the same transaction.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.validate_state(r text,z text) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $fn$
BEGIN
 PERFORM data.validate_pre_contract_state(r,z);
 PERFORM data.validate_conditions(r,z);
 PERFORM data.validate_identity_exclusions(r,z);
 PERFORM data.validate_record_projection(r,z);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_definition c WHERE c.release_id=r AND
  (c.name='SourceRecordProduct' OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_hierarchy h
   JOIN sem.class_definition root ON root.release_id=h.release_id AND root.class_id=h.ancestor_id
   WHERE h.release_id=r AND h.class_id=c.class_id AND root.name='SourceRecordProduct')) AND
  (EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.membership m WHERE m.release_id=r AND m.realization_id=z AND m.class_id=c.class_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.typed_value v WHERE v.release_id=r AND v.realization_id=z AND v.datatype=c.class_id))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'private record product cannot be a knowledge graph class or datatype' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $fn$

DECLARE expected_policy_version text;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r AND profile='semantic-2')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusions require composed execution capability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.id=x.observation_id AND o.release_id=r
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND x.exclusion_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     'identity-exclusion:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(r,z,o.observation_key,x.local_id)),'UTF8')),'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion identity differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.release_id=x.release_id AND o.id=x.observation_id
  WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
   WHERE d->>'id'=x.local_id AND d->>'reason'=x.reason
     AND d->'left'->>'kind'=x.left_kind AND d->'left'->>'target'=x.left_ref
     AND d->'right'->>'kind'=x.right_kind AND d->'right'->>'target'=x.right_ref
     AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
                WHERE e->>'outcome'='located' AND e->>'role'='primary')
  )) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion source declaration differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z) THEN
  SELECT operation.value->>'policy_version' INTO expected_policy_version
  FROM sem.registry_row model
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(model.body,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') operation(value)
  WHERE model.release_id=r AND model.kind='execution_model' AND operation.value->>'id'='resolve_identity';
  IF expected_policy_version IS NULL OR expected_policy_version='' OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z
    AND (x.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'resolve_identity'
         OR x.operation_version IS DISTINCT FROM expected_policy_version))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion operation version differs from release model' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
     JOIN data.evidence ev USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
       substring(ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address) FROM 5)::jsonb END address) native
     JOIN kb.observation o ON o.id=x.observation_id AND o.release_id=r
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
     WHERE xe.release_id=r AND xe.realization_id=z AND xe.exclusion_id=x.exclusion_id
       AND es.observation_id=x.observation_id AND d->>'id'=x.local_id
       AND e->>'outcome'='located' AND e->>'role'='primary'
       AND (e->>'start')::bigint=(native.address->>'start')::bigint
       AND (e->>'end')::bigint=(native.address->>'end')::bigint
       AND ev.locator::jsonb=jsonb_build_object('locator',e->'locator','start',(e->>'start')::bigint,
         'end',(e->>'end')::bigint,'role',e->'role')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion lacks located primary custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(x.left_kind,x.left_ref,x.left_entity_id),(x.right_kind,x.right_ref,x.right_entity_id)) ep(kind,ref,entity)
  WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT (
   (ep.kind='local' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.entity_source src WHERE src.release_id=r AND src.realization_id=z
       AND src.observation_id=x.observation_id AND src.local_id=ep.ref AND src.entity_id=ep.entity)) OR
   (ep.kind='known' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.entity_input i WHERE i.release_id=r AND i.realization_id=z
       AND i.input_entity_id=ep.ref AND i.entity_id=ep.entity)) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion prior
     JOIN data.entity_input l ON l.release_id=r AND l.realization_id=z AND l.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id
       AND l.input_entity_id=prior.left_entity_id AND l.entity_id=x.left_entity_id
     JOIN data.entity_input rr ON rr.release_id=r AND rr.realization_id=z AND rr.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id
       AND rr.input_entity_id=prior.right_entity_id AND rr.entity_id=x.right_entity_id
     WHERE prior.release_id=r AND prior.observation_id=x.observation_id AND prior.local_id=x.local_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion endpoint assignment differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT (
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.run job JOIN ops.input_cut cut ON cut.run_id=job.id AND cut.final
     JOIN ops.cut_task ct ON ct.cut_id=cut.id JOIN kb.observation o ON o.task_id=ct.origin_task_id
     WHERE job.release_id=r AND job.result_realization_id=z AND o.id=x.observation_id) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion prior
     JOIN data.entity_input l ON l.release_id=r AND l.realization_id=z AND l.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND l.input_entity_id=prior.left_entity_id AND l.entity_id=x.left_entity_id
     JOIN data.entity_input rr ON rr.release_id=r AND rr.realization_id=z AND rr.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND rr.input_entity_id=prior.right_entity_id AND rr.entity_id=x.right_entity_id
     WHERE prior.release_id=r AND prior.observation_id=x.observation_id AND prior.local_id=x.local_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion source outside effective cut or input binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH expected AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(e->>'start')::bigint start_offset,(e->>'end')::bigint end_offset,e->>'role' role,e->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.release_id=r AND o.id=x.observation_id
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND d->>'id'=x.local_id AND e->>'outcome'='located'
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,e->>'start',e->>'end',e->>'role',e->>'locator'
 ), actual AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint start_offset,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint end_offset,
     ev.locator::jsonb->>'role' role,ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   JOIN data.evidence ev USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
     substring(ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address) FROM 5)::jsonb END address) native
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id=x.observation_id
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint,ev.locator::jsonb->>'role',ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator'
 ) SELECT FROM ((SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)
   UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)) mismatch)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence differs from source citations' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe JOIN data.identity_exclusion x USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   LEFT JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   WHERE xe.release_id=r AND xe.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.observation_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence outside source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END
